 WHEREAS 
 
 The Lessee is a real estate developer and has undertaken a real estate project named and styled as “Z AMEEN ACE MALL ”, comprising inter alia commercial shops, hotel apartments and residential apartments located at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA, Islamabad (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Lessor is the sole, absolute and exclusive owner of a commercial shop ( “ Demised Premises ” ) in “ ZAMEEN ACE MALL ” , purchased by the Lessor from the Lessee vide Agreement to Sell No. _______________ dated ________ executed by and between the Parties for sale and leaseback of the commercial shop ; and 
 
 Pursuant to the terms and conditions of the aforementioned Agreement to Sell, the Lessor desires to lease back to the Lessee, and the Lessee desires to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Lease back Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , Lessor and Lessee, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in the Leaseback Agreement (defined below), along with the Agreement to Sell , and any other document ( s ) forming part of the Leaseback Agreement pursuant to the term s and conditions hereof , shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parti es hereto in respect of the lease back of the Demised Premises (defined below) . 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the leaseback of the Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of this Leaseback Agreement (the “ Leaseback Agreement ”): 
 
 This Leaseback Agreement; 
 Description of Purchased Unit; 
 Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions; 
 Any other document incorporated by reference in this Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 The documents specified in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions attached to the Agreement to Sell , followed by the Agreement to Sell , and D escription of the Purchased Unit attached to the Agreement to Sell . Any terms used as defined terms and not defined in the Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to them in the Agreement to Sell . The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Lease back Agreement. 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell executed by and between the Les see and the Less or for the sale and leaseback of the Demised Premises, as specified in Recital (B) of th is Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any U nit including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system s , lobbies and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system s , tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Demised Premises and do not form part of any given Unit . 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or th is Lease back Agreement. 
 
 Demised Premises means the purchased u nit as specified in Recital (B) above and more fully described in the Description of the Purchased Unit ap pended to the Agreement to Sell . For the avoidance of doubt, any reference to the Demised Premises , where the context so permits, shall also be a reference to the Purchased Unit as defined under the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 18 . 
 
 Leaseback Agreement has the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Nominee has the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Party means the Lessee or the Lessor, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ Zameen Ace Mall’ , being constructed and developed at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA, Islamabad . 
 
 Purchase Price shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rent means the annual rent payable by the Lessee to the Lessor for leaseback of the Demised Premises as specified in Clause 8 of th is Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 Except where the context otherwise requires, references in th is Lease back Agreement to:

 Any headings herein are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders;

 Any reference to a Party shall, where the con text permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of th is Leaseback Agreement or any part there of; 
 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing including an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 Where there is a reference to “lease”, “leaseback” or other disposition of interest in any unit by the Lessor to the Lessee, such term refers to the disposition of interest of the Lessor’s rights relating to the Demised Premises, including the right to occupy and use such Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to th is Leaseback Agreement ; 
 
 Any term not defined in th is Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 TERM OF LEASE 
 
 The Lessor hereby agrees to leaseback , and the Lessee hereby agrees to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises f rom the Effective Date up to a period of t hree ( 3 ) year s , or the Completion Date , whichever comes earlier, as specified in the Agreement to Sell (“ Term ”) . 
 
 RENT 
 
 The Lessor shall be entitled to Rent in consideration of the lease of the Demised Premises during the Term , provided that the Lessee has fulfilled his/her payment obligations with respect to the Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit under the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Rent shall be calculated as a percentage of the aggregate payment of the Purchase Price ( or portion thereof ) , deposited in clear funds by the Lessor under the Agreement to Sell, in accordance with the following rates : 
 
 SERIAL NO. 
 AGGREGATE PAYMENT S AS PER THE PAYMENT PLAN AGAIN S T THE PURCHASE D UNIT 
 RENT RATE (PER ANNUM) 
 1 
 50% to 74% 
 6% 
 2 
 75% to 94% 
 9% 
 3 
 95% 
 12% 
 
 Rent shall be paid by the Lessee to the Lessor in equal monthly instalment ( s ) , on or before the 10 th day of each calendar month. 
 
 OTHER CHARGES 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne and paid by the Parties in accordance with law. 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Lessor shall only sell / transfer the Demised Premises in accordance with the terms and conditions set out in the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 L ESSOR ’ S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessor hereby undertakes and agrees that : 
 
 the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Lease Period ; and 
 
 The Lessor shall not cause the Demised Premise s to become subject to any lien, charge or encumbrance whatsoever. 
 
 LESSEE ’ S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessee hereby undertakes and agrees to pay the agreed Rent on a monthly basis, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement . 
 
 WARRANTIES 
 The Lessor confirms and warrants : 
 
 that all details provided by the Lessor herein are true and correct in all respects ; 
 
 that the Lessor (and where there is more than one Lessor , each such Lessor ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Leaseback Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder ; 
 
 that it has good, valid, legal and subsisting title to the Demised Premises and is fully authorized to leaseback the Demised Premises; 
 
 not to lease, assign, mortgage, encumber or otherwise hypothecate any interest in the Demised Premises other than in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the Agreement to Sell; and 
 
 that the grant of this leaseback is in compliance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 EVENTS OF DEFAULT 
 
 In the event of default of payment by the Lessor under the Agreement to Sell, the Lessor shall not be entitled to Rent for the period of such default until such time as the default is remedied . It is stated for the sake of clarity, that the Rent payable for the period of default shall be forfeited and accordingly deducted from the total Rent due for the corresponding year . 
 
 TERMINATION AND CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION 
 
 T his Lease back Agreement shall expire on: 
 
 The Completion Date ; 
 
 The termination of the Agreement to Sell; 
 
 The date on which the Parties mutually agree to terminate the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 Upon termination of this Leaseback Agreement any payment due from the Lessee to the Lessor shall be settled by the Lessee within sixty (60) days from the date of termination , subject to the provisions of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means any event or occurrence beyond the control of the Lessee (including but not limited to any injunction/stay order, government notification, spread of infectious disease on the Project site) that prevents the Lessee from completing or performing its obligations under the Agreement. The Lessee shall not be liable for such non-completion or non-performance under the Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue . S hould an Event of Force Majeure occur, the Lessee shall promptly notify the Lessor of the event . 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Leaseback Agreement along with the Agreement t o Sell , constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and overrides, supersedes, cancels any other negotiations, commitments, discussions, representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, with respect to the leaseback of the Demised Premises, whether made by the Lesse e , any agent, employee or representative of the Lessee or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, showroom displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Lessor or made available for his/her viewing and, upon acceptance by the Lessee , th is Leaseback Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject to the terms and conditions contained herein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in th is Leaseback Agreement, any modification or amendment to th is Leaseback Agreement shall be in writing and expressly stating the intention to modify, amend or waive any provision of th is Leaseback Agreement, duly signed by both Parties. 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 The Leaseback Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to th is Leaseback Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan and subject to this C lause 21 , the Courts at Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction . 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to th is Leaseback Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act 1940. After the lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator (s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under this Leaseback Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty -eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in th is Leaseback Agreement or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in case there is more than one Lessor , notice to any one Lessor shall be deemed as notice to all Lessors and the Lessee shall be under no obligation to write to each Lessor individually. 
 
 Lessor shall notify the Lessee in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Lessor’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect the validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Lessee to the Lessor at the last known address. 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and any documents, data, notices or information disclosed or shared by the Lessee, oral or written, shall be regarded as confidential information by the Lessor and the Lessor shall take all reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality of all such confidential information and shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties, except where such disclosure is required under any law or court order. This C lause 26 shall survive the termination or expiry of this Agreement. 
 
 S URVIVAL 
 The Leaseback Agreement shall en s ure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assignees. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 The Leaseback Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 WAIVER 
 The delay or failure of either Party to enforce or insist upon strict compliance with any of the terms or conditions of th is Lease back Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of said Party’s rights hereunder. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 If any one or more provisions of th is Leaseback Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under th is Leaseback Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 The Lessor hereby confirms having read and understood th is Leaseback Agreement in its entirety and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
